column1: NAICS code stands for the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code. It is a six-digit code that represents the product, activity, or service at a facility or supplier. The codes are listed in the Federal Register and defined in “North American Industrial Classification System Manual 2007,” available from the U.S. Department of Commerce at http://www.census.gov/eos/www/naics/.
All emissions data is presented in units of metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent using GWP's from IPCC's AR4 (see FAQs tab)
